description: This file contains partial class definitions, extension methods, and options related to Azure Storage-based reminders for Orleans. It defines classes for storage options, validators, extension methods for silo builder integration, and an implementation of a reminder table that interacts with Azure Table Storage.

classes.name: AzureStorageOperationOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for Azure Storage operations, including table client options, storage policy, and table service client configuration.

classes.name: AzureStorageOperationOptionsValidator<TOptions>
classes.description: Validator for AzureStorageOperationOptions and its subclasses, ensuring proper configuration.

classes.name: AzureStoragePolicyOptions
classes.description: Specifies policy parameters such as timeouts and retry counts for Azure Storage operations.

classes.name: AzureTableReminderStorageOptions
classes.description: Options specific to Azure Table Storage for Orleans reminders, including default table name.

classes.name: AzureBasedReminderTable
classes.description: Implementation of IReminderTable that interacts with Azure Table Storage to read, write, and manage reminder entries.

methods.name: UseAzureTableReminderService
methods.description: Extension methods for configuring Azure Table Reminder Service in the SiloBuilder or ServiceCollection.

methods.name: ConfigureTableServiceClient
methods.description: Obsolete methods to set up TableServiceClient directly in AzureStorageOperationOptions.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Method to validate the configuration of AzureStorageOperationOptions.
